    //==
    // # Constant and function-valued field algebra
    //
    // Bodies for the constant fields of `fields.types.plato` and the
    // function-valued fields of `fields.types.plato`, plus the combinator
    // algebra over them: lifting any field interface implementor into stored-function
    // form, pointwise composition, and constructive solid geometry on distance
    // fields. Every combinator returns a NEW field holding the composed lambda.

    //==
    // # Constant fields
    //
    // The trivial fields: the same value at every point. Their evaluation ignores
    // the position entirely, which is what makes them the neutral leaves of a
    // field expression.

    // The constant value, at every point of the plane.
    Eval(self: ConstantScalarField2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Value;
```

    //==
    // # Function-valued fields
    //
    // Evaluation of a field that STORES a function: invoke the stored function.
    // This is the base case that makes the combinators below possible — each one
    // builds a new field whose stored function closes over the operand fields.

    // The stored function applied to the position.
    Eval(self: ScalarFunctionField2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Function(point);
```

    // The blob field value: the summed influence of every ball, less Threshold.
    // Negative outside the blob, zero on its outline, positive inside — note this
    // is the OPPOSITE sign convention to a signed distance field.
    Eval(self: MetaBallSystem2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Balls.Reduce(0.0, (total, ball) => total + ball.InfluenceAt(point)) - self.Threshold;
```

    //==
    // # Function-valued implicit shape algebra
    //
    // Bodies for the stored-function implicit shapes of
    // `implicit-sdf.types.plato`: evaluation, the lifts from any SDF interface
    // implementor, and the CSG algebra closed over each form — SDF booleans are
    // min/max on the stored distance, region booleans are the Boolean connectives
    // on the stored predicate.
    //
    // Every SDF operator here defers to the matching `*Distance` kernel in
    // `implicit-sdf.library.plato` and inherits the fidelity claim stated there —
    // exact, a lower bound, or not a bound (`implicit-sdf.concepts.plato`). A
    // region or volume operator carries no distance and so no such claim.

    // The stored distance function applied to the position.
    Eval(self: FunctionSdf2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Function(point);
```
